title: Collision census (walls, jump, grenade)
summary: One Story session. An idle control, then 30 s of walking into walls, jumping and throwing a grenade. The census of the collide phase is ranked against the idle control and the physics/collision functions are attributed by tools.physics_attribution (T1727). Session folder tmp/owner-profiles/collide-STAMP.
duration: about 10 minutes after the game is up
prerequisites: Game HDD tmp/hdds/profile-hdd (your Story profile). The script builds the private host first, which takes a few minutes.
A Story save in a level (the ingame scenarios start at Story 2401) with a wall nearby and open floor, and a grenade available.

steps.text: Press Enter at 'Enter = start the game'. When the window opens drive to Story yourself and load a level. Nothing is measured until you continue at a phase prompt.

note_at_end: Whether the grenade bounced, whether you stuck to or slid along walls, anything odd (falling through floor, clipping).
If the game stopped: the 'unimplemented instruction at ...' or STOP line.
stop: Enter in this terminal starts and again ends a phase. s skips, q finishes. Close the window only after the last phase.
send_back: Tell Claude the session finished: folder tmp/owner-profiles/collide-STAMP (the physics attribution table is printed at the end).

ingame-idle.title: Idle control
ingame-idle.go_to: A spot next to a wall in the level
ingame-idle.do: Stand still. Do not press any button and do not move the stick.

ingame-collide.title: Walls, jump, grenade
ingame-collide.go_to: The same spot, next to a wall with open floor
ingame-collide.do: Walk into the wall and slide along it, jump several times (also against the wall), then throw a grenade and watch it bounce. Keep going for the whole window.
